critical_code_review_comments: Login response returns field 'token' (not 'access_token' as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md line for admin). Consider updating test_credentials.md or aliasing so downstream test agents don't fail — I added a fallback (access_token or token) in the test file to keep this iteration green.

internalize_expertise (rm_expertise.py ~L210) recomputes rules on every learning cycle via delete_many + insert_one loop; for high-frequency learn cycles this could churn the collection — consider upsert-by-source_id or a single bulk write.

Rule count varies (5 for 'default' vs 4-6 depending on data — inelastic bucket and LRV rule are conditional). Assertion rules_count>=5 currently passes for default but city-gate can return 4 (asserted >=4). Consider documenting the min/max range in the endpoint response schema.
expertise_context_for_llm truncates knowledge bodies to 160 chars — combined with 10 expert rules and sensitivity buckets this may still balloon the system prompt for chat; consider a total-char cap.
No admin API to edit/disable a specific expert rule at runtime; entire set is regenerated. If a user wants to override or pin a rule, they can't.
